extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a product: (fg)' = f'g + fg'

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a quotient: (f/g)' = (f'g - fg')/g², provided g(x) ≠ 0

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose derivative exists

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The instantaneous rate of change, denoted f'(x) or d/dx

extracted_concepts.name: Leibniz Notation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Notation such as d/dx(uv) = u'v + uv' and d/dx(u/v) = (u'v - uv')/v²

extracted_concepts.name: Function f
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A differentiable function denoted f

extracted_concepts.name: Function g
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A differentiable function denoted g

extracted_concepts.name: Three-or-More Product Rule
aliases: 三个或更多因子的乘积法则
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(uvw) = u'vw + uv'w + uvw'

extracted_concepts.name: Nonzero Denominator Condition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The quotient rule requires g(x) ≠ 0

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule Memory Aid
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Low d-high minus high d-low, all over the square of what's below

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives beyond the first, such as f'', f''', and f⁽⁴⁾

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of f', denoted f''(x) = d²f/dx²

extracted_concepts.name: Third Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the second derivative

extracted_concepts.name: Fourth Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A higher-order derivative denoted f⁽⁴(x)

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function s(t)
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function s(t) giving position as a function of time

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity v(t)
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of position: s'(t) = v(t)

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration a(t)
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of velocity: s''(t) = a(t)

extracted_concepts.name: Jerk
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of acceleration: s'''(t)

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule Example x²e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(x²e^x) = 2x·e^x + x²·e^x = xe^x(2 + x)

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule Example sin x / x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(sin x / x) = (x cos x - sin x)/x²

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation Operator d/dx
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operator that takes the derivative with respect to x
